_comment: FOUR different molecules, with FOUR different net charges and a spin
multiplicity that varies frame to frame -- 670 frames from OMol25.
C2Cl1H5Si1     charge  0    9 atoms
C1H1O4S2       charge -1    8 atoms
C4H8N1O5P1S1   charge -2   20 atoms
C11H20N1       charge +1   32 atoms
Each is its own DeePMD system, because a system is one fixed composition
and atom count. They train together as one model.

_comment_type_map: The GLOBAL element list: the union over every system. Each system's own
type_map.raw is different (C,Cl,H,Si / C,H,O,S / C,H,N,O,P,S / C,H,N)
and its type.raw indexes THAT list, not this one. DeePMD-kit remaps at
load time, which is what lets systems with different element subsets
share one model without renumbering anything.

_comment: add_chg_spin_ebd is what makes the model READ charge_spin.npy. It is
part of DPA4C's structural signature, so in a multi-head model it
must be true for EVERY branch, and turning it on later invalidates
existing checkpoints -- decide before the first long run.
default_chg_spin is the neutral-singlet fallback for systems that
carry no charge_spin.npy. It is deliberately NOT in the signature.
Charges are projected onto each FRAME's total charge, read from
column 0 of charge_spin. So they sum to 0, -1, -2 or +1 depending
on which system the batch came from.
'isolated' sums q_i q_j erf(alpha r)/r directly over every pair --
the SAME quantity the periodic examples evaluate in reciprocal
space, so alpha must match them (0.4 in 01-bulk and 03-slab).
No mesh, no pbc, no slab_correction: those describe a sum over
periodic images, and passing one is an error, not a no-op.

loss._comment: No cell, so no virial label: its prefactors stay 0.

_comment: All four systems listed together. DeePMD-kit draws each batch from ONE
system, which is why differing atom counts cost nothing -- no padding
is ever needed across compositions. auto_prob weights the systems by
how many batches each holds; 'prob_uniform' would weight them equally.
